texts.text: Fire Dept: hazmat chemical spill in lab, floor 8, Regency Square Tower, 6200 Savoy Dr. Meet crew at front entrance with building keys, floor 8 lab chemical info and HVAC shutoff.

tenant_flags.tenant: Unknown tenant (Suite 802; two records, 1,506 and 2,681 sq ft)
tenant_flags.risk: Unidentified occupant on the spill floor. This is the only floor-8 space that could plausibly be the lab.
tenant_flags.why: Suite 802 is listed twice under 'Unknown tenant', so it's not clear whether that's one tenant or two. None of the named floor-8 tenants looks like a lab: Couch | Lambert A Regional Law Firm (the listed Suite 440 doesn't match floor 8), Governmental Data Services Inc, BTIC America Corporation and Howard Day & Associates Inc (Suite 810). They have 2 to 6 employees each, so headcount is low. There are no descriptions for any tenant, and the only industry listed for the building is professional, scientific and technical services. Treat 802 as the possible lab source until it's confirmed.

tenant_flags.risk: Possible patients or vulnerable occupants, and possible medical supplies or gases, on the floor directly below the spill.
tenant_flags.why: The name says healthcare services, but there's no description and the suite is unknown. Being right below floor 8 puts it at risk if liquid seeps down or vapor spreads. Check whether patients are on site and prioritize warning and evacuating them.

tenant_flags.risk: Possible clinic patients or vulnerable occupants who may need help evacuating.
tenant_flags.why: The name suggests a healthcare provider or clinic. There's no description and the suite is unknown. It's three floors below the spill, so it matters if the building has to be evacuated or sheltered in place.
